#### 1. Start with the monitoring records
Check whether the reports include a table or graph of monitoring records for the facility.
Factories emit pollutants into the environment and legally those emissions are supposed to be monitored.

Most PRC facilities are violating environmental regulations by emitting more pollutants than their permits allow and/or emitting pollutants without monitoring, neither of which are supposed to be legal. Look for discrepancies between the amount of a pollutant emitted as reported to be emitted according to monitoring records and the emissions figure reported to the database.

Note whether the monitoring records show more or less pollution than the emissions factor.

#### 2. Check whether the pollution figures reported to the monitoring platform and/or database are correct
